name: organizational-intelligence-blueprint
description: Andrew Odewahn's organizational intelligence system brings an expert review layer to your toughest problems.

interface.shortDescription: Andrew Odewahn's organizational intelligence system brings an expert review layer to your toughest problems.
interface.longDescription: Map your org's key systems, build a reasoning skill specific to your team, and ground hard decisions in cited O'Reilly frameworks, so you get a clear recommendation instead of generic suggestions.
defaultPrompt: How can I apply Andrew Odewahn's organizational intelligence article to my team?
I need better organizational intelligence. Our AI reports just summarize data. Make them recommend something.
Should our platform team hire another engineer? Help me map where our team's knowledge lives.
